## Override authorization: CONTEXT_SUFFICIENT_BY_TARGETED_VERIFICATION_WITH_AUTOMATED_ROLE_ADEQUACY_FALSE_NEGATIVE

Raw automated roleAdequacy (from implementation-capsule.json, preserved truthfully, not relabeled):
  role: implementation
  status: "context insufficient and more retrieval required"
  missingConditions: ["required evidence truncated"]
  blockingConditions: [] (empty — no hard-blocking condition was actually triggered; only the soft "required evidence truncated" condition)
  truncationImpact: true
  truncated evidence groups: implementation-compatibility-surfaces (used 8 of 29 available, 21 dropped), implementation-contracts (used 39 of 47 available, 8 dropped)
  A second, narrower probe request (focusFiles reduced to a single file, requestedEvidenceKinds reduced to ["owner","contracts"]) still truncated implementation-compatibility-surfaces (19 of 29 available) — confirming the truncation is driven by my-dev-kit's fixed per-role evidence-group reservation budget (governingHardBound = 84 items shared across 9 required categories: owners:3, dependencies:10, callers-and-callees:15, contracts:10, validators-and-constants:10, errors:10, schemas-and-serializers:10, compatibility-surfaces:8, closest-tests:8 — see src/context/evidenceGroups.ts lines 577-587), not by query/focus shaping. This repository indexes 2242 symbols; the compatibility-surfaces/contracts candidate pools structurally exceed these fixed reservations regardless of how narrowly the request is scoped.

Why this is structurally unavoidable on this repository (not a request-shaping problem):
  src/context/contextRoleAdequacy.ts (~line 195-197): `const truncationImpact = truncation.records.some((r) => r.requiredEvidenceLost); if (truncationImpact) missingConditions.push('required evidence truncated')` — this fires unconditionally on ANY dropped required-group item, with no threshold and no per-repo-size scaling. Every evidence group in the role===implementation branch is allocated with `required: true` (src/context/evidenceGroups.ts lines 632-640), so this condition is structurally guaranteed to fire whenever aggregate required-candidate volume exceeds the fixed 84-item shared budget, which a 269-file/2242-symbol repository does by a wide margin (29-47 available items in the two affected groups alone).
  `limits.evidenceGroupEntries` (the one request-level limit override available, src/context/types.ts line 78) is documented in the tool's own source as "deliberately independent" of these per-group hard limits (src/context/evidenceGroups.ts line 98) — there is no supported request field that raises the actual group reservations.
